items.label: Teachers
items.name: Comparte Universidad
items.text: Online seminars with European lecturers for students and teachers at CUDEP, the most remote campus of Guatemala's public university. Since 2018, more than 1,500 people trained.

items.label: Young people and climate
items.name: Comparte Educación
items.text: Five modules on the climate crisis for girls and boys aged 13 to 17. The first edition, in Nuevo Horizonte with INAB and MARN, involved 27 students.

items.label: Communities
items.name: Comparte Comunidad
items.text: Agricultural training in the communities where zeroCO2 plants trees. Soil, harvests and practices that help every day.

cuba.title: Glasses and medicines, for more than 4 years
cuba.text: In Havana we support the Belén home for the elderly and primary schools in the city and the province. We bring prescription glasses and medicines where the embargo makes them hard to find.

impact.title: What we have done so far

about.title: Born over lunch, in 2018
about.text: A group of young Italians and Guatemalans, sitting at the table, asked themselves what the communities of Petén really lacked. The answer: good education and practical tools. That is how Comparte began; in Spanish the name means "share". We started with cinema: between 2018 and 2020 Comparte Cinema screenings, with Cuba's ICAIC, reached 7 rural communities.

donate.title: How to donate
donate.fiveText: If you pay taxes in Italy, sign the box for Third Sector organisations in your tax return and write our tax code. It costs you nothing.

donate.note: Donations fund all our work, in Petén and in Cuba. If you pay taxes in Italy, they are tax-deductible under the rules for Third Sector organisations. Keep your transfer receipt.

items.q: What do you do in Cuba?
items.a: For more than 4 years we have brought prescription glasses and medicines to the Belén home for the elderly and to primary schools in Havana and the province.

To our active projects in Petén: university training with USAC, climate education in Nuevo Horizonte and agricultural training with rural communities. The report is published every year on the Transparency page.
An association founded in 2018 between Rome and Petén. We train teachers and students, bring climate education to schools and agricultural training to rural communities in Guatemala.

Yes. Andrea Pesce founded both. zeroCO2 plants trees in rural communities in Petén, and Comparte brings training and education to the same communities. They are independent and work together on the ground.
